senses.gloss: m. (בוס, בסס; formed like עָצִיץ) anything to tread upon; footstool, stand, base (= b. h. כַּן, מְכוֹנָה).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:7">Kel. XI, 7</cite> <he>הפרח והב׳</he> the bud (receptacle of the candlestick) and the stand.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25:8">Lev. R. s. 25</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:15:1">Cant. R. to V, 15</cite> like a column which has <he>ב׳ מלמטן וכ׳</he> a base beneath &c.; Tanḥ. B’har 1.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:2:6">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᵈ</cite> top <he>בשאין עליהן ב׳</he> when there is upon them (the idolatrous emblems) no stand (indicating that they were intended for practical use).

Ib. כוס בסוס לדרקון וכ׳ (corr. acc.) if the cup serves as a stand for the dragon (idolatrous emblem), it (the cup) is forbidden; a. fr.—Trnsf. (in Sabbath law) whatever is subservient to another object, e.g. the case in which a book is kept, the table upon which a lamp is placed.

<cite ref="Shabbat 117a:1">Sabb. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ לדבר האסור</he> subservient to an object which must not be handled on the Sabbath; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="B00999"><he>בְּסִיסַי</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00999"><he>בְּסִיסִית</he></cite>.
